briefdescription.para: Non-zero when COSE and required CBOR/crypto dependencies are enabled.
Zero-Heap CBOR Object Signing and Encryption (COSE - RFC 9052 / RFC 8152).

detaileddescription.para:
Implements COSE_Sign1 (Tag 18) and COSE_Encrypt0 (Tag 16) for constrained IoT nodes. Supported Cryptographic Algorithms:
EdDSA (-8): Pure C99 Ed25519 signature scheme (RFC 8032).
ES256 (-7): ECDSA over NIST P-256 curve with SHA-256 (RFC 9053).
ChaCha20/Poly1305 (24): Authenticated encryption with associated data (RFC 9053).
